title: SuperTag Volume manifest
description: A Volume manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.VolumeSpec in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

VolumeSpec.description: A Volume's source and credential name, and the `spec` of a `Volume` manifest. Apply replaces it whole.

source.description: Where the data lives: `s3://BUCKET/PREFIX`, `r2://BUCKET/PREFIX`, `file:///ABSOLUTE/PATH` on the Worker Host, and for native mounts `gs://BUCKET/PREFIX/` or `modal-volume://NAME/PREFIX/`. S3 and R2 accept the `region`, `endpoint` and `forcePathStyle` query parameters. Credentials, fragments, and `.` or `..` segments are refused.

credential.description: The name each Worker Host maps to a secret, a provider-held reference or its consent. Never a secret value: one that looks like a key is refused.
